title: Kissed Smoky Filipino Shrimp Stew
description: A jammy, crisp Filipino shrimp stew with smoky paprika and a touch of tamarind, perfect for a quick pescatarian lunch.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and diced bell pepper, cooking for another 2 minutes.
Sprinkle smoked paprika and crushed red pepper flakes, tossing to coat the aromatics for 30 seconds.
Pour in coconut milk and fish stock, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Add tamarind paste and soy sauce, stirring until well combined.
Gently fold in peeled shrimp, simmering until pink and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt if needed, then stir in chopped cilantro.
Remove from heat and let the stew rest for 2 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, optionally accompanied by steamed rice or crusty bread.
